handoff.salientSummary: Implemented GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id endpoint with validation for UUID format (400), task retrieval (200), and not found (404). Added 4 test cases, all passing. Manual curl verification confirmed all three scenarios work correctly.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: Created GET /api/v1/evaluations/:id handler that: (1) Validates UUID format and returns 400 if invalid, (2) Calls evalRepo.GetByID to fetch evaluation from database, (3) Returns 404 if evaluation not found, (4) Returns 200 with full task details (id, model name, dataset name, status, config, progress, created_at) if found. Also added GetEvaluationResponse struct and fixed repository to return ErrNotFound for proper 404 handling. Added route v1.GET("/evaluations/:id", evalHandler.GetEvaluation) in main.go. Tests cover all four scenarios.
